info.title: NOBS Inventory API
info.summary: Read-only access to the inventory for other tools.
info.description: The token API of NOBS Inventory (server/api-routes.js): devices, contracts, licences and, for a token made with them, people. Every route only reads. An admin makes and revokes the tokens in Settings → Users → Access; a token is shown once and sent as `Authorization: Bearer nobs_…`. A token is no session: the rest of the app's API stays closed to it. Wrong tokens count against the address, like wrong sign-ins: after too many, the address gets 429 for 15 minutes. Answers are not cached (`Cache-Control: no-store`). The CSV lists start with a byte order mark, so Excel reads them as UTF-8; a cell that starts with = + - @ is written with a leading apostrophe.

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: The devices of the inventory, not those waiting in To review.

tags.name: People
tags.description: Only for a token made with people.

get.description: The devices of the inventory, filtered by the parameters given. With a token made with people, each device also names its user and their department.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only devices of this type, by its key (pc, notebook, server, switch, monitor, … or a type added in Settings).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only devices whose inventory number, name, serial number, model, IP or MAC address contains this text (not case-sensitive).

text/csv.description: With format=csv. Columns: id, code, name, typeLabel, model, serial, status, location, ip, mac, os, purchased, warranty, and user, department for a token made with people.

get.description: One device by its inventory number, its id or its serial number.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Inventory number (INV-0001), id or serial number.

404.description: No such device, or it waits in To review.

get.description: Each contract's terms, its next end and notice date, and the devices it covers. No notes, no contacts.

text/csv.description: With format=csv. Columns: id, name, kind, supplier, ref, start, end, renewMonths, noticeMonths, noticeBy, state, cost, per, devices (the inventory numbers, separated by spaces).

get.description: Each licence's seats, how many devices have the software, its cost and end.

text/csv.description: With format=csv. Columns: id, name, seats, used, free, over, cost, per, end.

get.description: The people the inventory knows: name, department, whether active, when they left, and how many devices they have. Only for a token made with people. No logins, no e-mail addresses.

text/csv.description: With format=csv. Columns: id, name, department, active, left, devices.

403.description: The token was made without people.

get.description: This OpenAPI document. No token needed: it holds no data.

token.description: An API token made by an admin in Settings → Users → Access. It starts with nobs_ and is shown once.

format.name: format
format.description: csv for a CSV file instead of JSON.

NoToken.description: No token, or not a valid one (revoked, mistyped).

Throttled.description: Too many wrong tokens from this address: try again in 15 minutes.

error.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

typeLabel.description: The type's name as the page shows it.

warranty.description: End of the warranty (YYYY-MM-DD), or empty.

user.description: The device's user. Only for a token made with people.

department.description: The user's department. Only for a token made with people.

intune.description: What Intune said at the last sync, or null for a device Intune does not know.

compliance.description: Intune's compliance state (compliant, noncompliant, …), or empty.

lastCheckIn.description: Last contact with Intune (ISO 8601), or empty.

end.description: The next end (after renewals), YYYY-MM-DD, or empty for no end.

renewMonths.description: Renews itself by this many months; 0 for not.

noticeBy.description: The last day to give notice, YYYY-MM-DD, or empty.

state.description: open: no end; soon: the notice or the end is within 60 days; late: the notice date has passed; ended: it has ended.

devices.description: The inventory numbers of the devices it covers.

used.description: Devices in use or in stock that have the software.

free.description: Seats left; negative when more are used than bought.

active.description: false for someone who left the directory.

left.description: When they left (YYYY-MM-DD). Only for someone who left.

devices.description: Devices they are the user of, not counting retired ones.
